query:
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM public.problem_catalog) AS problem_count,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.tutorial_catalog) AS tutorial_count,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.tutorial_drafts) AS draft_count,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.tutorial_changes) AS history_count,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.progress) AS progress_count,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.learning_records) AS learning_record_count,
(SELECT md5(string_agg(md5(to_jsonb(p)::text),',' ORDER BY problem_id)) FROM public.problem_catalog p) AS problem_hash,
(SELECT md5(string_agg(md5(to_jsonb(t)::text),',' ORDER BY id)) FROM public.tutorial_catalog t) AS tutorial_hash;
